purpose: Current additive exterior authoring rules. Map footprints, placement, heights and identities are read from the current spatial source; native pane positions are read from authored meshes.
dimension_status: Millimetre details and service layouts are architectural reconstruction estimates, not survey measurements.
principles: Preserve authored silhouette and all existing non-owned mesh objects.
Glazing seals and opening hardware use existing native pane geometry, rather than regenerating a second facade rhythm.
Roof services fit within the solid footprint and current upper-volume roof datum.
New entry orientation is an inferred nearest-road choice, checked against nearby map obstacles.
Open gates and stands receive relevant anchor or seating details; they never receive a generic building envelope.
Observation images remain external inputs; no third-party pixels are embedded in these materials.
